gaps.sentence: It was ___ honour to meet the ambassador.
gaps.explanation: 'Honour' starts with a vowel sound (silent h), so 'an honour'.
Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.
'The courage he showed' — the relative clause makes it definite.

gaps.sentence: ___ Lake Constance lies between Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
gaps.explanation: Lakes take no article when 'Lake' comes first.

gaps.sentence: We bought ___ antique mirror at the flea market.
gaps.explanation: 'An antique mirror' — 'antique' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: The tour included ___ visit to the British Museum.
gaps.explanation: 'A visit' (one of many possible) and 'the British Museum' (museums take 'the').

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.
